adjudication_notes.description: PCA analysis for 96b08e959ca - BUG/MEDIUM: ktls: defer TLS ULP
adjudication_notes.verdict: No compatibility changes found. This is a pure bug fix that defers TCP_ULP enable from ssl_sock_start (too early, socket may not be ESTABLISHED) to ssl_sock_setup_ktls/ha_ssl_ctrl (after handshake complete). All changes are either additive macro defines or internal static functions. The fix only improves behavior - kTLS now works where it previously silently failed.

HUNK-0001.reason: Additive new #define flag. Not a breaking change.

HUNK-0002.reason: New static function. Internal-only, not a public API.

HUNK-0003.reason: Behavioral bug fix in ha_ssl_ctrl BIO_CTRL_SET_KTLS. Internal BIO callback.

HUNK-0004.reason: Removed premature setsockopt(TCP_ULP) from ssl_sock_start. Core of the bug fix, internal.

HUNK-0005.reason: Added ktls_enable_ulp() call in ssl_sock_setup_ktls. Deferred to correct time. Internal static function.
